q: A global attractor 𝒜 for a dissipative PDE semigroup is characterized by:
opts: Being compact, invariant (S(t)𝒜=𝒜), and attracting all bounded sets
Being equal to the unstable manifold of the origin
exp: A global attractor is the maximal compact invariant set that attracts all bounded sets. Its existence requires dissipativity (energy dissipation) and compactness of the semigroup (a smoothing property). Examples: Navier–Stokes, Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equations.
